result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: a typo in the search placeholder and awkward clipping in horizontally scrolling content.

issues.description: The search placeholder says “Restarants, dishes, groceries”; “Restaurants” is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries.”

issues.description: The category and “Fastest near you” rows end with partially visible items at the right edge, including an apparently blank category chip and truncated restaurant name. This looks unintentionally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding and scroll snapping, or adjust item widths so the next item is shown as a clearer, intentional scroll cue without clipping its label.
